summary.zh: 两个人互相猜：我知道你知道我知道。25 个有出处的案例（空城计、福尔摩斯与莫里亚蒂、爱伦·坡的猜单双……），每个都能按"双方各猜几层"算出结果。先在 cases 里找案例的编号，再用 compute 跑。
summary.en: Two people guessing each other: I know that you know that I know. 25 sourced cases (the Empty Fort, Holmes and Moriarty, Poe's odd-or-even…), each of which can be computed for "how many levels each side reasons". Find a case id in `cases`, then run `compute`.

description.zh: 每个案例：故事梗概、两个人物、博弈的结构、出处。_id 就是 compute 要的 case_id，_group 是类别（bluff、cheap_talk、common_knowledge、coordination、implicature）。
description.en: Each case: the story, the two characters, the structure of the game and the source. `_id` is the case_id that `compute` takes and `_group` the category (bluff, cheap_talk, common_knowledge, coordination, implicature).

datasets.licence: MIT (summaries written for this repository; quoted works keep their own copyright)

provenance.zh: source 字段写明作品、作者、位置、引文和网址；verified 为 true 的是对着原文核对过引文的。只有中文。
provenance.en: The `source` field gives the work, author, locator, quotation and URL; `verified: true` means the quotation was checked against the original. Chinese only.

description.zh: 给定案例和双方各猜几层，算出每个人在每一层怎么想、最后各自怎么选、结果如何。确定性，不调用模型。
description.en: Given a case and how many levels each side reasons, compute what each thinks at every level, what each finally chooses and the outcome. Deterministic; no model is called.

case_id.description: cases 数据集里的 _id，例如 kongchengji / the _id from the `cases` dataset, e.g. kongchengji

depth_a.description: 甲猜几层；不给就用原作里的 / levels A reasons; the original story's when omitted

depth_b.description: 乙猜几层 / levels B reasons

lam_a.description: 甲的理性度，越大越接近最优反应 / A's rationality; higher is closer to best response

true_state.description: 信号博弈里真实的状态是第几个 / index of the true state in a signalling game

ladder_depth.description: "多猜一层会怎样"的阶梯算到几层 / how far the what-if-one-level-deeper ladder goes

output.zh: 一个对象：两个人每一层的信念和选择、最终的选择和收益、与均衡的比较、阶梯。
output.en: An object: each side's beliefs and choices per level, the final choices and payoffs, a comparison with equilibrium, and the ladder.
